review_notes: Independently reconciled the single purpose correction and functionality document against canonical CARDRename.c lines 7-71 and CARDBios.c lines 649-696, 787-799. Existing names and inherited retained knowledge remain supported; renderer callback association is not evidence. Accepted deferral of target char signedness and detailed CARDDir completion/persistence recovery because neither is required by the proposed local-interface correction.
unresolved: The source compares char filename prefixes to 0xFF; target char signedness was not independently established, so the intended forbidden-prefix guard is not generalized into a portability claim.
Detailed asynchronous completion, callback invocation, and persistence-failure recovery inside CARDDir were not independently audited; only the local submission and release boundary is asserted.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical CARDRename.c confirms filename validation, identity-filtered directory scanning, collision rejection, access checking, filename/timestamp mutation, and directory-update submission. Lines 65-71 independently establish the synchronous wrapper and its immediate-error branch; CARDBios.c lines 787-799 confirm synchronization waits. The functionality document preserves error precedence and local release boundaries. Accepted deferrals concerning char signedness and detailed asynchronous persistence recovery do not undermine this correction.

contradictions.reason: The upstream supersession is justified: the previous unit-purpose rationale excluded CARDRename, but canonical source contains this synchronous wrapper alongside CARDRenameAsync.
